名词所有格: The legs of the table are short.
情态动词 can / could: She could not go to school.
感官动词与 like 表比喻: The cloud looks like a sheep.
There be 句型: There is a cat on the bed.
There are five apples in the box.
There was a big tree here.
have / has 表拥有: The dog has a long tail.
let / make / help + 动词原形: Please help me find my cat.
Mom makes me clean my room.
动词不定式 to do: I want to read a book.
We use paper to make books.
一般将来时: We will go to the park.
比较级与最高级: The rabbit is faster than the dog.
Tom is the tallest boy in class.
My bag is as big as yours.
时间与条件从句: We play outside when it is sunny.
If it rains, we stay at home.
After school, I do my homework.
have to / must: I have to do my homework.
She has to wear a coat.
We must not run in the hall.
